questions.question: When the Lamb opened the seventh seal, what filled heaven?

answers.text: Silence for about half an hour
A new song before the throne
A sound like a mighty wind

questions.question: An angel with a golden censer was given much incense to offer at the altar. What did he offer with it?

answers.text: The prayers of all the saints
The crowns of all the elders
The palm branches of the crowd

questions.question: When the first of seven angels sounded his trumpet, what was hurled down upon the earth?

answers.text: Hail and fire mixed with blood

questions.question: An eagle flying overhead cried woe to those who dwell on the earth. What was it warning about?

answers.text: The trumpets of the last three angels
A storm about to hit the seas
A famine coming upon the land
